By agreement

Where the money comes from

A Classic launch shares its fees — in the open

The token trades on a Meteora curve, then graduates to a Meteora pool. Each fee is split by published rules.

Curve trading fee

1% on each curve trade

20%Meteora
32%Creator
48%Ryntra

Graduation fee

2% of what the curve raised

40%Creator
60%Ryntra

Pool fees

After graduation; liquidity locked

20%Meteora
20%Creator
40%Back into the pool
20%Ryntra

A creator partner's share comes only from Ryntra's part — never from the creator's, never from volume.

Classic and Protected presets; Micro and Advanced split differently. A volatility fee can add to the curve fee; the pool split holds while the locked positions are its liquidity.

For creators

Why creators launch on Ryntra

Classic and Protected launches. Three separate things belong to the creator:

32%

of every curve trading fee

40% of what is left after Meteora's 20%. A share of the fee, not of the trade.

40%

of the graduation fee

The 2% fee on what the curve raised, when the market moves to its pool.

50%

of the locked launch liquidity

Ownership of half the pool position locked at graduation — it keeps collecting pool fees.

Simple launch

Three steps and one signature; only Solana's network cost.

Fees known upfront

Every split is published and shown before signing.

A market that stays

Liquidity is locked at graduation — no one can withdraw it.

Partner tools & rules

Everything a partner needs — and rules that protect your name

Personal link

Rewards → Creator partners gives ryntra.io/r/<code>. The creator sees «Invited by» before signing.

Media kit

The brand, the launch fee rules and ready words to post.

Weekly boards & badges

Boards for traders, friends and creators; badges at 1, 3, 10 and 25 activated creators.

Seasons

8-week seasons with tasks start next.

No pay for posts

Shares come only from creators who launched with your link.

No profit promises

No promises of income or price, and no price predictions — from Ryntra or from partners.

Review, not a ban

Wash trading goes to a person; proven manipulation cancels the reward.

Versioned terms

Change only by a new version, with notice. What was earned stays.

Marked as an ad

Partner posts carry «Ad» or «Paid Partnership».

No self-referral

Your own and your team's wallets earn nothing.
